observations.body: The psalm says Israel made a calf, exchanged glory for an animal image, forgot the savior, and would have been destroyed had Moses not stood in the breach.
observations.label: The calf at Horeb is remembered with intercession

observations.body: The calf at Horeb is remembered with intercession belongs to sinai remembered in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Psalms 106:19–23 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Psalms 106:19–23 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The calf at Horeb is remembered with intercession belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
